translated_title: Mexico's Exports Grew 37.9 Percent and Imports 33.1 Percent Annually in September
original_title: Las exportaciones crecieron 37.9 por ciento y las importaciones 33.1 por ciento anual en septiembre
author: Clara Zepeda
meta_description: September exports hit a record 77.8 billion dollars, led by a 94.7 percent jump in electronics, and the year-to-date trade balance is now in surplus.
